subject: Disagreement between usual and standardized readings would support investigating measurement differences.
rationale: Under the stated pairing and comparability requirements, disagreement would give a defensible reason to investigate measurement differences, consistent with comparing explanations through potentially discriminating evidence. The target already identifies differing receiving methods. An unspecified disagreement threshold limits evidential weight but does not defeat this modest investigative consequence. The relation neither establishes measurement error as the cause nor assumes disagreement has occurred.
